Sam: FYI seeing large number of GPU attach failures in us-east1 over last 25m. Attach logs reference NVMe timeouts on scratch devices so kube fails to mount.
Ravi: Any recent infra pushes?
Sam: We rolled nvme FW 2.3.1 to a subset ~40m ago. Failures seem grouped to nodes tagged fw=2.3.1.
Jun: Paste a sample error?
Sam: ```Attach failed: timeout waiting for block device (/dev/nvme0n1) ready, last I/O err=I/O timeout
kernel: nvme0: I/O 0 QID 10 timeout
SMART: media_errors +18 in 12m```
Maya: OpsBot alert: "ephemeral-cleaner IO saturation - us-east1 - 12 hosts" :rotating_light:
OpsBot: [alert] ephemeral-cleaner throughput x10 baseline; device P99 latency >400ms.
Ravi: Pattern looks like cleaner deep-scan triggering random small writes that stress FW GC path -> tail latency spikes.
Luca: Quick checks: `iostat -x 1 5 /dev/nvme0n1`, `nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1`, `journalctl -u ephemeral-cleaner -n200`.
Sam: On node-34 (fw=2.3.1): util ~99%, await 180-220ms, smart shows temp_warning and media_errors spike, cleaner logs show concurrent deep-scan jobs.
Jun: Mitigations: 1) throttle cleaner concurrency for fw=2.3.1 cohort (janitor.max_workers=1) 2) temporarily steer new GPU attaches away from cohort 3) rollback FW on worst hosts.
Maya: Can we apply (1) now? How to scope?
Ravi: We have config flag: `ephemeral.cleaner.concurrency.override[region="us-east1",fw="2.3.1"] = 1`. Push via config service; ~90s to controllers.
Luca: I'll prepare a canary: apply to 5 nodes then watch iops & attach success. Also add attach-routing preference to favor us-central for 1h.
Sam: Note cost: cross-region diversion ~+$850/hr if sustained, but acceptable versus failed attaches.
Jun: Open vendor ticket with sample smart logs & kernel traces (nvme-trace).
Maya: Success criteria: iops drop <3x baseline and attach success >95% sustained for 10m; p99 attach latency <150ms.
Ravi: Also monitor `nvme.media_errors` and `attach_latency_p99`. If media_errors stop increasing, can restore concurrency slowly.
Sam: Actions: Luca pushes concurrency override & attach-route change. Jun files vendor ticket. Maya monitors.
Luca: pushing config now (`cfg push ephemeral.cleaner.override`) -> rolling out to controllers. Tagging nodes fw=2.3.1.
OpsBot: [deploy] config push detected: ephemeral.cleaner.override -> rollout started.
Maya: Dashboards show util drop on canary nodes after ~2.5m. p99 latency falling from ~420ms to ~85ms.
Sam: Good. Keep route pref until full cohort stabilized.
Ravi: If any nodes still don't recover after vendor guidance, plan controlled FW rollback.
Jun: Starting postmortem stub: include timeline, cohort list, cleaner tuning, estimated cross-region cost and customer impact.
Maya: Will update with vendor ticket # and decision on rollback. :white_check_mark:
